name: How do I know if my kitchen has enough space for an island?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my kitchen has enough space for an island?

acceptedAnswer.text: To add a functional kitchen island, your room generally needs at least 36 to 42 inches of clear walkway space on all sides, with 48 inches preferred for multi-cook kitchens. This clearance ensures that oven doors, dishwashers, and low pull-out cabinets can open fully without blocking passage. If your existing room width is too narrow, an island will obstruct everyday movement. In tighter spaces, practical alternatives include a peninsula layout, which provides extra prep counter space and seating without requiring two separate walking aisles.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need at least 36 to 42 inches of open aisle space around all sides of an island so appliances and cabinet doors can open without restricting traffic flow.
